He was going to select me to be the captain of the team, the leader I had always wanted to be. My heart was racing with anticipation. But when his next words hit my ears, everything changed. "We're going to have to send you home," he said coldly. "I don't think you are going to make it." I couldn't believe his decision. I tried to hold it together, but inside I was falling apart. A car would be waiting tomorrow morning to take me home. And just like that, it was over.

det.analysis: 본문 'A car would be waiting tomorrow morning to take me home'에서 다음 날 아침 화자를 데려갈 것은 'A car'(차)
det.tip: A car would be waiting = 차 한 대가 기다릴 예정이었다

questions.passage: My heart was __________ (race) with anticipation. But when his next words hit my ears, everything changed. "We're going to have to send you home," he said coldly. "I don't think you are going to make it."
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로 쓰시오)

det.korean: be동사(was) 뒤 과거진행을 만드는 현재분사 racing
det.analysis: 빈칸 앞 was는 과거진행형(was + V-ing)을 이끈다. 기대감에 심장이 빠르게 뛰고 있던 진행 상황이므로 race → racing. was racing(빠르게 뛰고 있었다)
det.tip: 과거진행: was + V-ing. was racing(빠르게 뛰고 있었다)

questions.passage: As I waited outside the locker room after a hard-fought basketball game, the coach called out to me, "David, walk with me." I figured he was going to tell me something important. He was going to select me to be the captain of the team, the leader I had always wanted to be. My heart was racing with anticipation. But when his next words hit my ears, everything changed. "We're going to have to send you home," he said coldly. "I don't think you are going to make it." I couldn't believe his decision. I tried to hold it together, but inside I was falling apart. A car would be waiting tomorrow morning to take me home. And just like that, it was over.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 주제로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 본문은 주장 선발을 기대하던 화자가 갑작스러운 방출 통보로 무너진 경험을 다룸
det.analysis:
❌ ① 주장의 조건: 본문은 조건이 아닌 개인적 경험을 서술
✅ ② 기대가 탈락 통보로 무너진 경험: 본문 전체가 주장 선발 기대 → 집으로 보낸다는 통보 → 좌절의 흐름을 서술 ←정답
❌ ③ 승리 전략: 본문과 무관
❌ ④ 코치-선수 관계: 본문의 핵심이 아님
det.tip: 제목 'A Dream Cut Short' = 짧게 끝나버린 꿈

ch: 훌륭한 팀 주장이 되기 위한 조건
큰 기대가 갑작스러운 탈락 통보로 무너진 경험

questions.stem: 다음 글의 요지로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 주장이 되리라는 기대가 방출 통보로 무너졌다
det.analysis:
✅ ① 기대가 통보로 무너짐: 본문의 핵심 흐름(기대 → 방출 통보 → 좌절)과 일치 ←정답
❌ ② 주장 임명: 본문은 방출 통보이므로 부적절
❌ ③ 경기 패배로 실망: 본문의 좌절은 경기 결과가 아닌 방출 때문 — 부적절
❌ ④ 따뜻한 위로: 본문 'said coldly'와 모순 — 부적절
det.tip: 요지 = 주장 기대 → 방출 통보 → 무너짐

ch: 주장이 될 것이라는 기대가 집으로 보내진다는 통보로 산산이 무너졌다.
코치는 화자를 따뜻한 말로 위로해 주었다.

questions.stem:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말을 주어진 조건에 따라 영작하시오. (영어로)

"그가 나에게 중요한 것을 말해 줄 것이었다"

[조건]
(1) going, something, he, tell, to, was, important, me를 모두 사용할 것
(2) 정확히 8단어로 쓸 것

det.korean: he was going to tell me something important = 그가 나에게 중요한 것을 말해 줄 것이었다
det.analysis: 빈칸은 'I figured _____' 구조. 과거 시점의 예정을 나타내는 'be going to'(was going to)와 -thing으로 끝나는 부정대명사의 후치수식(something important)을 활용. he was going to tell me something important가 적절
det.tip: be going to + 동사원형 = ~할 예정이다. something important(후치수식)

questions.wa: he was going to tell me something important
accept: he was going to tell me something important
